# Forbes: Ralliant's Amir Kazmi on Wiring AI Into Critical Infrastructure


Forbes features Chief Technology & Growth Officer Amir Kazmi discussing how Ralliant is embedding AI into the Ralliant Business System (RBS), industrial operations, and critical infrastructure to accelerate decision-making, improve operational resilience, and support long-term growth.
